notes: Supplemental data for the Master's thesis "Ab-initio Molecular Dynamics of the Solvation of Manganese Ions". Files are named after the corresponding simulation in the thesis. Filetypes .radial: radial distribution functions and coordination number; atom types are indicated by the file name (Mn: manganese, O: oxygen, H: hydrogen) .angle: angular probability distribution; atom types are indicated by the file name (Mn: manganese, O: oxygen, H: hydrogen) .hbonds_c: average number of hydrogen bonds per molecule; some files only count hydrogen bonds for a selected number of oxygen atoms indicated by NAMES in the file's header .xyz: final atomic configurations in the unit cell .mp4: videos illustrating dynamics processes For more detailed information please consult the thesis or the paw_structure Python package mentioned therein.
